solutionSql:
SELECT s.tracking_code, c.name AS customer_name
FROM shipments AS s
JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = s.customer_id
WHERE s.status = 'delivered'
ORDER BY s.tracking_code;
ambiguities: "Delivered" is not tied to a column in the text. I used shipments.status = 'delivered'. shipment_events also has 'delivered' rows, which would give a different answer if the author meant an event.
The starter selects customer_id, which is not in resultColumns. I replaced the select list with tracking_code and customers.name AS customer_name, which needs the join.
notes: Inner join on the non-null customer foreign key to the unique customers.id, so no fan-out. Row counts differ by dataset (66 sample, 120 nulls, 43 boundary) because the shipments seeds differ. tracking_code is unique, so the order has no ties.
